data.body: **[P1] Route scope fatals through invocation finalization.** If a handler scope reports a fatal while suspension or retry has already won, this direct throw bypasses the downstream `handle` that calls `onInvocationEnd`. Plugins are then released without `RETRYING` finalization, potentially dropping OTel spans and Insight exports. Return a failed future carrying the fatal at both checks so the existing fatal branch finalizes plugins before rethrowing, and add an executor test asserting this lifecycle ordering.
